description: Pinned inputs for the Floe Linux guest image candidate. Every value here was observed by the TinyEMU qualification runs (run 35500083112, branch codex/feedback-linux). The component-image-ci workflow reads this file; it must never be edited to make a check pass, only as a reviewed input upgrade.

engine.name: TinyEMU
engine.license: MIT (core); slirp BSD-2-Clause; sha256.c/aes.c public domain
engine.patch_note: The qualification Makefile applies every *.patch in order and greps the FENCE marker, so a build whose 0005 did not land fails immediately (upstream TinyEMU trapped FENCE.TSO as illegal, which killed Debian's libapt-pkg with SIGILL). 0003 is Apple-guarded and 0004 only fixes a slirp debug format string; neither changes RISC-V behavior.

demo_archive.name: diskimage-linux-riscv-2018-09-23
demo_archive.license_note: Qualification-only source of the boot loader and fallback kernel. The buildroot rootfs in this archive is never shipped; only bbl64.bin and kernel-riscv64.bin are copied into the candidate image.

bios_source.license: BSD-3-Clause (Regents of the University of California)

debian_image.url_note: Debian rotates daily cloud builds; the dated directory is the pinned URL and the SHA-512 below is the trust anchor. If the dated directory is gone, the input is unavailable and the build must fail rather than silently use another daily build.

rootfs_partition.features_after_clear: has_journal ext_attr resize_inode dir_index filetype extent 64bit flex_bg sparse_super large_file huge_file dir_nlink extra_isize metadata_csum

debian_image.layout_note: The 2018 bbl/kernel has no EFI/GPT partition parser, so the ext4 rootfs is extracted from the GPT image and booted as a partitionless whole-disk image (root=/dev/vda). The Debian 6.12 kernel boots is not used: it produces no console output under the 2018 bbl (Linux removed legacy SBI v0.1 in 5.9).

guest_runner.cmdline_note: The fallback kernel has no RTC. The Floe host appends floe.epoch=<Date()> on every boot (LinuxGuestImage.effectiveCmdline); the runner consumes it as PID 1 and sets CLOCK_REALTIME. The candidate image must be verified with this parameter, never with a separate date -s workaround.

preparation_note: The host's shared Python venv (/floe/env/python/venv) and Node module/bin paths (/floe/env/...) need python3-venv, python3-pip, nodejs and npm inside the guest; base64 is part of coreutils. pnpm is not installed implicitly.
